value.rationale: The number and location of stationary positional concentration peaks are natural observables for a spatially inhomogeneous two-state active particle. The exact three-peak wedge overturns the conditional two-mode assumption in the primary model and gives a true, stable alternative shape regime, with a sharp fold line and a sixth-order codimension-two peak. This is structurally stronger than a sample plot, familiar stationary-density formula, or routine parameter recoding; it leaves the full noncommensurate problem open.
